subject: Multiple duplicate orders appearing in system for same customer
description: Since this morning, we have been receiving duplicate orders through our online ordering system. Customers placing single orders are finding that their orders are being duplicated in the kitchen display system, causing confusion and incorrect order fulfillment. This has resulted in multiple complaints from customers and wasted food preparation. The issue appears to be intermittent but has occurred at least 8 times in the last 2 hours. No changes were made to the ordering system recently. Please investigate the order processing logic on the network router.
